{{Quote|They struck with cunning and ferocity, cutting down the most experienced Witches during the deepest hour of night. No Witch still in our caves survived that night.|Kaminne Sihn on the massacre|<ref name="backlash" />}}
The '''Raining Leaves Clan massacre''' occurred sometime in [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]], when a large number of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], a traditionalist and matriarchal [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] clan, revolted against their masters.<ref name="backlash" />

The men struck at night, [[Death/Legends|killing]] all the Witches in the clan. In a single night, the Raining Leaves Clan lost all of its most experienced Witches. The only ones that survived were the ones who were away on errands or out hunting. When the surviving Witches learned of the uprising, they retaliated by using their spells to cut down all males over the age of ten.<ref name="backlash" />
